data.body: **[P1] Do not export the deterministic operation span before completion.** Ending this span publishes its deterministic `operation_id_to_span_id`, but after resumption `on_operation_end()` recreates another span with the same trace/span ID. A wait or callback spanning invocations therefore exports conflicting `STARTED` and terminal records, and collectors may discard or overwrite the authoritative result. Keep unfinished operations as non-recording placeholders until terminal completion, or use unique IDs plus links for per-invocation segments. Add a wait/resume test asserting exported span identities are unique.
